newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Record volume of NZ 90-day bill futures traded.
newsitem.headline: Record volume of NZ 90-day bill futures traded.

text.p: The volume of New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures traded on Tuesday was an all-time record 10,236 contracts, the New Zealand Futures and Options Exchange said.
An NZFOE spokesman said it was the highest volume traded since the inception of the 90-day bill future in June 1989.
The volume corresponded to NZ$5.1 billion in nominal value.

The NZFOE said the market reacted sharply to the September quarter CPI figure announced earlier in the day, with the December contract settling at 9.02 percent compared to Monday's close at 9.34 percent.
